name: A4
mesh_airframe: none: the A-4 is physics-only (no licensed model)

license.unavailable: no licensed A-4 model. The FSX / P3D A-4E/F/G/H/K package the owner downloaded is by Dino Cattaneo / IndiaFoxtEcho Visual Simulations (c) 2019 (its flight manual's credits; every aircraft.cfg says ui_createdby="IndiaFoxtEcho Visual Simulations"), its visual model is partly based on MeshFactory meshes bought through TurboSquid, and its terms read: 'Other than for personal uses of the purchaser, copying, modifying or redistributing this software is illegal.' Converting it and rendering it into a public dataset is neither, so it is not used; an earlier commit that credited the owner as its author was wrong and is corrected here. Physics-only until a model whose licence allows it exists (written permission from IndiaFoxtEcho, or an openly licensed A-4 model).

dimensions_m.source: [unverified here] published A-4F overall length 40 ft 3 in (12.27 m) and height 15 ft (4.57 m), from memory of the type's standard characteristics; span is taken from the flown FDM's own <wingspan>

nose.source: the FDM's structural origin taken as the nose tip (Aeromatic v0.9, which generated A4.xml, references its stations from the nose); z at the CG waterline

tail.source: nose tip + the type's overall length 12.27 m [unverified here] at the CG waterline

limits.note: A4.xml is an Aeromatic v0.9 model 'created using publicly available data, publicly available technical reports, textbooks, and guesses' (its own file header): unvalidated, so every limit monitored against it would be graded on a guessed airframe.
